text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's finally begun! Golshi's ultimate<n>multiple-choice
one-question birthday<n>quiz!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Go on, pick your poison! Is your<n>present in my right
pocket—or my left?<n>I swear upon McQueen's name
that<n>the correct answer is one of these<n>two choices!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the odds are a perfect<n>50/50... Heh,
now that's more like it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna take this lightly,<n>you'd best just
give up. Answer right<n>for the pearly gates, and
wrong for<n>molten lava... Your life's on the line,<n>and
you only got one chance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You gotta wager your life—that's whatit means to go all in!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Sounds good to me! The<n>pressure's got
every cell in my body<n>on edge!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, my hands are tremblin'!<n>Who woulda
thought I'd be wagerin'<n>my life for my birthday?
You're a real<n>one, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I knew you wouldn't back down from<n>a challenge.
There's no turning back<n>now, Nakayama! Now
choose—right or<n>left!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whewie! Not bad at all! You got it right,<n>so you get
this carrot-scented eraser!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I gotta thank you, Golshi. Notevery day I get to feel thrills likethese... Feel like a newborn baby rightnow.
